stories.title: The price of eating well Prosper
stories.excerpt: A plate of roasted beef with salad. Roast beef salad is rich in lean protein from the roast beef, which helps keep you full and satisfied. PHOTO/MICHAEL…
stories.summary: The affordability challenge is unfolding alongside changes in Uganda’s food environment, where packaged, processed and ultra-processed foods are increasingly available to consumers. Research published in September 2026 found that 72.1 per cent of the 1,083 packaged processed and ultra-processed food products assessed in Uganda were ultra-processed. PHOTO/ MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI Changing food environment The consequences of Uganda’s changing food environment extend beyond individual health, with the growing burden of NCDs also imposing costs on households, businesses and the wider economy.
